title: Note attributedTo used directly as From: without RFC 5322 format validation
description: Trigger: inbound Create{Note} where attributedTo is a URL such as 'https://mastodon.social/users/alice'. note_to_article writes From: https://mastodon.social/users/alice. This is not a valid RFC 5322 address. validate_post_headers accepts it (it does not enforce RFC 5322 mailbox format) but downstream parsers (MUAs, NNTP readers) may reject or mangle the article. When attributedTo is missing, the fallback 'unknown@activitypub.invalid' also bypasses RFC 5322 validation. An article injected through the ActivityPub path has a different From: format than one posted via NNTP, which breaks client threading and filtering based on From.
